title: On Tending the garden for thirty years
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：tend　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tend 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the athlete ① tended the garden for thirty years at once, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② tends the garden for thirty years in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ tend the garden for thirty years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ tended the garden for thirty years before — a line in the programme for September 1963 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Tending the garden for thirty years at once, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ tend to be late every autumn in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Tend to be late every autumn at once and never mention it again.

By 1976 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ tends to be late every autumn at once every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ tended the garden for thirty years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To tend the garden for thirty years, my mother said in 1981, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody tends the garden for thirty years in the rain again and somebody must tend the garden for thirty years at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 照料（一般过去式 tended the garden for thirty years：1969 年运动员头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 照料（一般现在 tends the garden for thirty years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 照料（不定式 to tend the garden for thirty years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 照料（过去完成时 had tended the garden for thirty years：1963 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 照料（动名词 tending the garden for thirty years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 往往（tend to be late every autumn：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去往往年年秋天总要晚些）
G. v. 往往（tend to be late every autumn：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 照料（后段两处：新来的陪练照例 tends to be late every autumn，而母亲又一次 tended the garden for thirty years）

answers.why: tend 意为“照料”，1969 年运动员二话不说地照料照料那个园子三十年，那是体育场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 tended。
tend 意为“照料”，自那以后运动员淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 tends。
tend 意为“照料”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯照料照料那个园子三十年”，此处为不定式 to tend the garden for thirty years。
tend 意为“照料”，秩序册里 九月 那行字说明早在 1976 年之前就有人照料过，故用过去完成时 had tended。
tend 意为“照料”，运动员说“照料照料那个园子三十年这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 tending the garden for thirty years 作主语。
tend 意为“往往”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去往往年年秋天总要晚些”，should ever 之后用原形 tend to be late every autumn。
tend 意为“往往”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻往往年年秋天总要晚些（tend to be late every autumn at once），以后再也不要提起。
tend 意为“照料”，新来的陪练每个年份都照例往往年年秋天总要晚些，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 tends。
tend 意为“照料”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地照料照料那个园子三十年，用一般过去式 tended 叙述。
tend 意为“照料”，结尾那句是母亲 1981 年的话：要照料照料那个园子三十年，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和体育场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 tend 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the athlete tended the garden for thirty years at once, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete tends the garden for thirty years in the rain whenever the stadium asks.
Tending the garden for thirty years at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever tend to be late every autumn in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium tends to be late every autumn at once every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother tended the garden for thirty years again, and the stadium remembered that half.
